$comment: Hand-edited input to scripts/generate-docs.mjs. Not generated — edit it, then run `pnpm docs:generate`. Adding a component without a category here fails the run on purpose.
$embedHeights: Every embed used to be 200px, which clipped calendars, charts, dialogs and every multi-state matrix. Resolution order, most specific first: a story's own `parameters.docs.embedHeight`, then byStory (Storybook story id), then byComponent, then byCategory, then default.
$maxExamples: Per-story-file and per-page caps on generated examples. Either a number, or { default, byComponent } for a per-component override.
$pageDescriptions: Hand-written page descriptions, used for the <meta> description, search results and nav cards. Only needed where the source cannot supply one: a compound component's root export carries a JSDoc about the root primitive ('Root component that manages open/close state…'), which is true of that export and useless as a description of the page. The generator lists every page that falls back to this, so the list stays short and visible.

pageDescriptions.Accordion: A vertically stacked set of headings that expand to reveal their content, built from Accordion, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger and AccordionContent.
pageDescriptions.Banner: A full-width promotional or informational banner in six variants, laid out vertically, horizontally or compactly, with optional actions and a dismiss control.
pageDescriptions.BottomNavigation: A fixed bottom bar of BottomNavigationAction items, for switching between the top-level sections of a mobile layout.
pageDescriptions.Breadcrumb: A trail of links showing where the current page sits in the hierarchy, built from BreadcrumbList, BreadcrumbItem, BreadcrumbLink, BreadcrumbPage and BreadcrumbSeparator.
pageDescriptions.Chart: The Recharts building blocks on @fanvue/ui/charts: ChartContainer and ChartStyle for theming, ChartTooltip, ChartLegend and ChartCard for the chrome, plus loading and skeleton states.
pageDescriptions.Dialog: A modal dialog, a centred card on desktop and a bottom sheet on mobile, built from DialogTrigger, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription, DialogBody and DialogFooter.
pageDescriptions.Drawer: A panel that slides in from the edge of the viewport, built from DrawerTrigger, DrawerContent, DrawerHeader, DrawerTitle, DrawerDescription and DrawerFooter.
pageDescriptions.DropdownMenu: A menu anchored to a trigger, built from DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuContent and its item, checkbox, radio, group, label and separator parts.
pageDescriptions.EmptyState: A placeholder for a view with nothing in it yet: media or icon, title, description and up to two actions, in five title and five media sizes.
pageDescriptions.InfoBox: An explanatory popover anchored to a trigger, built from InfoBoxTrigger and InfoBoxContent.
pageDescriptions.PasswordField: A password input with a show/hide toggle, in three sizes, taking the rest of its API from TextField.
pageDescriptions.RadioGroup: A set of Radio items where exactly one can be selected, controlled or uncontrolled.
pageDescriptions.Table: A data table built from TableCard, TableScrollArea, TableToolbar, TableHeader, TableRow, TableCell and TablePagination, plus a dozen cell-level parts.
pageDescriptions.Tabs: A tabbed interface built from Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger and TabsContent.
pageDescriptions.Tooltip: A short label shown on hover or focus, built from TooltipProvider, TooltipTrigger and TooltipContent, with twelve placements.
